scene.note: Your functions go through each list item by item and give back something new, leaving the list as it was.

steps.note: The thermometer on the tops logs readings through the night, some below freezing.
The lowest so far starts as a reading from the list, and only a lower one replaces it.
Once every reading has been looked at, the coldest comes back.
The bags going in the vehicle are weighed one by one.
Python's own functions count them, add them up, and find the lightest and the heaviest.
One line for the sheet says it all.
The heaviest bags go in at the back of the vehicle first.
A new list comes out in order, heaviest first, and the weighed list keeps its order.
Dougie loads from the new list.
The kit is a list of names with no numbers.
Each item gets its number from 1, and a line goes onto a new list on every round.
The numbered lines come back, one per item.
A lower on the crag needs ropes of at least some length.
Each rope is kept only if it is long enough, in one line that builds the new list.
The ropes that will do come back in the order they hang in the store.
